withdrawal_queued.meaning: user has queued a withdrawal of a specified kHYPE amount via queueWithdrawal

hype_amount_at_queue.meaning: HYPE amount the user can withdraw as determined by the exchange rate at queue time

min_period_elapsed.meaning: minimum withdrawal period (7 days minimum) has ended before confirmation

rate_decreased_between.meaning: exchange rate decreased during the period between queue and confirmation (e.g., due to slashing)

hype_amount_at_confirmation.meaning: HYPE amount that the exchange rate at confirmation time would determine as payable

hype_amount_paid_on_confirmation.meaning: HYPE amount actually paid on confirmation, computed from the queue-time amount

assumptions: The exchange rate at confirmation time is observable and yields a well-defined HYPE amount payable.
The queue-time HYPE amount is fixed at queue time and carried into confirmation.
The rate decrease is treated as an external event (e.g., slashing) rather than attacker-induced.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the exchange-rate formula or fee handling needed to compute the confirmation-time HYPE amount numerically; the relation is kept symbolic.
Report does not establish whether the rate decrease is attacker-induced or external, so the scenario is formalized as a potential external decrease.

limitations: The selected impact 'effectively extracting value from the protocol' is formalized as the paid amount differing from the confirmation-time rate amount; the 20 HYPE profit figure is not part of this claim.
Bank-run and insolvency impacts are not covered by this plan.
The 7-day minimum is represented as an elapsed-period Boolean rather than a numeric duration comparison.
